def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,3))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # copy marker's 3x3 neighborhood pattern (cross/shape) as painted marker where background zero
    # Each occurrence of the marker pattern in the zero/3 noise is translated as the 3x3 stencil.
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    # derive marker pattern bounding box
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    # infer pattern instances at offsets: match marker shape on zeros (only required locations must be zero)
    for ar in range(h-(r1-r0)):
      for ac in range(w-(c1-c0)):
        if all(grid[ar+dr][ac+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[ar+dr][ac+dc]=marker
    return out
PY
